sections.When to use this: You have finished a change on a branch and committed it. A push to `main` is rejected, so a pull request is the only route in. If you are here because a build broke, you want a [runbook](../runbooks.md) instead.
sections.Prerequisites:
* A branch off `main`, carrying the change as commits.
* The `gh` CLI signed in to `paul80nd/knowledge-as-code`.
* `kac` run as `dotnet run --project tooling/kac --`, which is the tool this branch holds.
